digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter comment sanitization
propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling at 32767 (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT) but jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-configurable with range 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647
when a DC administrator raises or removes the comment ceiling above 32767, rebar silently truncates comments that Jira would accept, causing data loss
the constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is misattributed in code comments to Cloud limits rather than Jira's configurable property jira.text.field.character.limit
sanitize_comment and fit_comment both depend on the shared description fitter through fit_outbound, creating risk that future description-fitting changes would incorrectly retarget comment truncation
the /rest/api/2/application-properties endpoint that exposes jira.text.field.character.limit requires Administer Jira global permission, making auto-discovery unavailable to rebar's non-admin PAT
